india.title: Verra Approves First Credits Under Rice Methodology
india.excerpt: Verra has approved the first carbon credits under its Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) methodology for improved management of rice production systems. The credits were generated by the Core Carbon Sustainable Rice Productions 01 project ( Verra Project 3243 ) in India, which has avoided over 210,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e) by implementing improved water and crop management practices in flooded rice paddies. The project is located in the coastal state of Telangana, a major rice-producing region in southern India. Participating farmers…

world.title: Optivolt Raises $32 Million to Make Solar Panels Smarter
world.excerpt: Power electronics company Optivolt announced that it has raised $32 million in a Series A funding round, with proceeds aimed at advancing its platform to build an intelligence layer for solar energy, turning passive solar hardware into adaptive power systems to adapt to different conditions and maximize energy output in a real-world setting. Founded in 2017 by CEO Rohit Kalyanpur, San Francisco-based Optivolt develops solar power electronics and intelligent panel technology. The company s solutions integrate power management, monitoring and safety…

world.title: UK Channels Oil Gas Revenues into New £2 Billion Clean Energy Wealth Fund
world.excerpt: The UK government announced the establishment of a new Energy Wealth Fund, focused on investing in renewable and low carbon energy projects, and funded from tax revenues from North Sea oil and gas. world.title: EIB Unveils €30 Billion Climate Adaptation Plan
world.excerpt: The European Investment Bank (EIB) Group announced a new plan to deliver at least €30 billion (USD$34 billion) for climate adaptation by 2030. The new plan will double the pace of the EIB Group’s financing compared with the last five years, channeling capital to projects to help Europe adapt to heatwaves, droughts, wildfires and floods, in areas ranging from energy networks and public buildings to water systems and climate-resilient agriculture. world.title: Revealed: Expensive gas behind ‘nearly 90%’ of rise in UK electricity bills

world.title: COP17: Developed countries ‘fall far short’ of UN targets for nature finance
